Dyslexic? Help us build the spell checker that gets you 🙌 Free for testers!

LexyLab is a spell checker designed for dyslexia, built by a dyslexic student. It understands words written the way they sound, works offline, on Windows and Mac (Mac in beta).

We're looking for:
• dyslexic people who write in English, to test it in their daily writing
• teachers, speech and language therapists and learning-support specialists, for honest feedback

Testing is 100% FREE for testers, with no commitment. Comment TEST or send us a DM 👇
